_comment: GL2.5d/e expectation matrix: what the symptom engine must find on each scenario table. Any active symptom not listed under 'expect' or 'allow' is unexpected. Findings held for workload evidence (needs-evidence) are ignored. Partition selectors: 'partitions' (exact set of partition values), 'newest' (only the table's newest partition), 'not_newest', 'min_value' (every flagged partition >= this value), 'prefix' (every flagged partition value starts with this; multi-field values are joined with '/'), 'count', 'min_count'; 'optional': true = allowed but not required (selectors still apply when it appears). 'fresh' marks a table whose check is only valid while its newest partition is younger than the hot window; past that the result is STALE, not FAIL. 'after' (optional): expectations once plan.py has applied fixes to the table (matched by table UUID, so a rebuild resets it to 'before'); an empty expect list means healthy.

after._comment: after make gl-plan T=s0 APPLY=1: both days compacted, old snapshots expired
one plan run compacts the top 10 of 11 flagged days; the 11th waits for the next run, and with 1 partition left SCATTERED clears
deletes applied to rewritten files and the old delete files removed

past day compacted, snapshots expired, today held while hot. Today may still be hot (HOT_PARTITION), cooled but not yet compacted (SMALL_FILES, next run's work), or compacted by a second run (healthy). Anything on the past day, or SNAPSHOT_BUILDUP, fails.
rewrite_manifests + expire_snapshots; merging stays off until approved, which only matters for future commits
no where clause (whole table), snapshots expired

glue.demo.s8_identity_bucket._comment: every eu commit writes to all 8 buckets, so the late-arrival rule may also fire; that's allowed

after._comment: scope widened from region='eu' + bucket to region='eu'
proves the hour-partition WHERE hit the right hours
eq deletes applied by the rewrite; remove-dangling-deletes drops the eq-delete files
proves quoting of string partition values in the WHERE

glue.demo.s12_cow_merge_churn._comment: copy-on-write merges: files look healthy, the table is rewritten ~12x; any SMALL_FILES would be held as advisory

after._comment: after make gl-step STEP=s12-mor: merge-on-read now, so churn is gone and the cost shows up as deletes (and small files from the merged rows) - work scheduled compaction already handles

glue.demo.s12_cow_merge_churn._comment_stale: REWRITE_CHURN needs table turnover over the last 24 h, so past 24 h after the build the scorecard says STALE (rebuild s12), not FAIL

after._comment: binpack splits the 20 MB file toward the 8 MB target
after make gl-plan T=s14 APPROVE=MIXED_SPEC: everything rewritten into the monthly spec

glue.demo.s15_metadata_retention._comment: the log holds 5 versions; older metadata.json files fall off it and stay in storage, so they also count as orphans

after._comment: after APPROVE=UNBOUNDED_RETENTION (delete-after-commit on); the files already left behind stay orphans until APPROVE=ORPHAN_FILES
after APPROVE=ORPHAN_FILES: remove_orphan_files deleted the stray objects

glue.demo.s18_sorted_small._comment: Group 1 fix: the table has a sort order, so compaction must use the sort strategy. filter_columns_evidence is 'observed' here so POOR_CLUSTERING is scored (approval) instead of held for evidence.

after._comment: after make gl-plan T=s18 APPLY=1: the sort rewrite leaves files with disjoint customer ranges; a binpack rewrite would leave POOR_CLUSTERING

glue.demo.s17_growing._comment: MAINTENANCE_LAG needs three scans with excess files rising (scan / make gl-step STEP=grow / scan / grow / scan); it's optional here so every scan in that sequence passes. Check the per-table output of the third scan for it. Two grow steps add 20 commits, so SNAPSHOT_BUILDUP may appear too.
